ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a side sectional view of a human head, showing structures such as the brain and brainstem, and using the letters A, B, C, D, E, F, G to label different parts. At the bottom of the brain, near behind the nasal cavity, a small downward-hanging/round structure can be seen, with a position close to the indicated area of label F. Reasoning: The question asks “What gland is found in the brain?” According to human anatomical knowledge, the small endocrine gland at the bottom of the brain, located below the hypothalamus, is the pituitary gland. Therefore the answer is pituitary gland.
